title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Lender Payment Record Credit on Renewals
content:
A lender that pays its program statements regularly earns a credit on the renewal rate under the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** residential renewal schedule (Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount tier).

**Lender payment record credit.** The program renewal rate per 100 is multiplied by 0.98 when the program received 10 or more lender payments in the last 12 months, by 0.99 when it received 6 to 9, and by 1.00 when it received fewer than 6.

Each lender remittance received on the program account is one payment, dated by the day received; a renewal window of the last 12 months covers every payment received on a day from which fewer than 12 whole calendar months have passed by today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached.

| Lender payments received in the last 12 months | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 6 | 1.00 |
| 6 to 9 | 0.99 |
| 10 or more | 0.98 |

*Question answered:* does the size of the payments matter? No — the rule counts payments received, not their amounts.
